description:
Activate Tinder Wall by sacrificing it.
When Tinder Wall dies, Mortuary and South Wind Avatar trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Tinder Wall from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the South Wind Avatar trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
South Wind Avatar triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life.
Cast Tinder Wall from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.
